comments.text: Europe has some fascinating examples of how humans can adapt to living alongside powerful rivers. The engineering is impressive, but the relationship with nature is even more interesting. 🌍🌊

replies.text: Exactly. Europe's approach is often more about working with the river than fighting it. The Dutch 'Room for the River' project is a perfect example—they moved dikes and restored floodplains to give water space again. It's a shift in mindset, not just technology.
